text:
Ari (Design): uploaded a new concept: 'Timeline Mini-Inspector' 14 lightweight right-side slip that appears on hover/focus. shows: small diff preview, runtime flags, health sparkline, and a 'Rollback confidence meter' (green/yellow/red). figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzzz/timeline-mini-inspector Tom (PM): nice. what's the meter based on? can it call out "canary short" or "metrics incomplete" states so PMs don't get false confidence? Ari (Design): meter rules: green = canary >= 30m && error-rate delta < 0.5%, yellow = short canary or marginal signal, red = error spike or no telemetry. clicking meter expands a details panel with the rule breakdown. Lena (Eng): :+1: good idea. implementation note: health sparkline and metric breakdown should be lazy-loaded and TTL-cached. large timelines will kill render otherwise. we'll return a small payload for the preview and fetch details on expand. Jon (A11y): accessibility nits: color alone can't convey confidence. include a textual status and an aria-live region for meter updates. Also keyboard: inspector must be focusable via timeline items and closable with Esc. Ari (Design): added visible label + title attribute. sample aria pattern in figma notes:
Confidence: High. Canary duration: 45 minutes.
Lena (Eng): prefer aria-atomic on that region so screen readers read the full sentence when it changes. also we should avoid auto-expanding details on focus to prevent surprise. Ari (Design): ack. details expand only on explicit Enter/Space or click. hover only reveals the mini strip. Rae (Product Ops): what about the rollback flows? there's pushback from support about accidental rollbacks if the CTA is too visible. suggested: two-step confirm with a small non-blocking toast undo for 3 minutes. Ari (Design): mock has two options: A) inline tiny rollback icon that opens a micro-popover confirm with two choices (Safe rollback / Emergency rollback), B) inspector-triggered slideout with fuller context and single CTA. which do we A/B? Tom (PM): let's A/B test the interaction. goal: minimize accidental reverts while keeping recovery time low. experiment ids: timeline_inspector_popover_v1 and timeline_inspector_slideout_v1. metrics: rollback_attempt, rollback_confirm, rollback_undo_3m, rollback_time_to_complete. Lena (Eng): engineering constraints: Safe rollback = gradual routing over 2m with a cancel endpoint; Emergency rollback = immediate switch. UI should surface this and call different backend endpoints. Also add server-side debounce for rollback_confirm to avoid duplicates. Jon (A11y): microcopy request: for the popover confirm, avoid verbs like "kill" or "revert" that are ambiguous. suggested copy: "Safe rollback: gradually reroute traffic to vX over 2 minutes (undo available)." and "Emergency rollback: immediate switch to vX (no auto-undo)." keep labels consistent with screen reader order. Ari (Design): updated copy in frames. also added an icon + textual hint for undo window. changed primary CTA text to "Confirm rollback (safe)" when safe mode, and "Confirm rollback (immediate)" for emergency. Rae (Product Ops): telemetry events to track: ``` rollback_intent rollback_confirm_safe rollback_confirm_emergency rollback_undo_within_3m ``` Make sure we include context attrs: revision_id, was_canary, canary_duration_mins, user_id. Lena (Eng): noted. will include those in the payload. for large diffs, show a "Load full diff" link that opens in a separate modal rather than embedding huge HTML in the inspector. lazy-fetch with aria-busy while loading. sample CSS snippet for reduced motion: .reveal { transition: max-height 200ms ease; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .reveal { transition: none; } } Jon (A11y): color contrast: current yellow warning icon falls below AA at 12px. bump contrast or add a thick outline. also ensure focus outline is visible when inspector is keyboard-opened. Ari (Design): adjusted colors and outline in the latest frame. also added keyboard focus states and explicit skip links for users who prefer keyboard-only navigation. ops-bot: snapshot created for design file 'timeline-mini-inspector' by Ari at 1766123560 Tom (PM): schedule a 10-min design review with Eng + A11y to decide default behavior. also please add a short note in release playbook about the undo endpoint behavior. Lena (Eng): i'll prototype the lazy load + api contract this sprint. ping me for the event schema before launching A/B. Ari (Design): thanks all 14 i'll update the figma and handoff doc with aria snippets, microcopy variations for the two variants, and the experiment IDs. moving to review board when prototype is ready.
